entity.name: Elixpo
entity.description: Elixpo is an open-source project foundry in India, a Udyam-registered MSME (UDYAM-WB-07-0152337). It builds FaleraOS and the Elixpo Falera Badge: open hardware, open software and the research behind them, all released under open licences. Three maintainers: Ayushman Bhattacharya (lead), Anwesha Chakraborty and Vivek Yadav.

projects.name: FaleraOS and the Elixpo Falera Badge
projects.description: FaleraOS is an open-source MicroPython operating system for the Elixpo Falera Badge, an open-hardware ESP32-S3 conference badge with a 2.8-inch touch screen, eight buttons, IR, a motion sensor, a speaker and microSD. It has an app SDK, an on-device App Store, over-the-air updates, a command-line tool (falera-cli) and RV565, a video format for small displays described in arXiv:2610.35935. The hardware is OSHWA-certified (IN000107) under CERN-OHL-P-2.0 and the software is MIT. Formerly OreoOS.

channels.description: The Falera Badge fundraiser on Elixpo Pay (UPI, cards and netbanking, in INR).

plans.name: The first five founder boards
plans.description: Bare PCBs from JLCPCB and parts from LCSC for the first five badges, paid out of pocket so far; the fundraiser's goal. Every price is in circuit/elixpo/BOM_COST.md.

plans.name: One badge
plans.description: The parts for one complete badge at the prices paid in November 2026 (board share, LCSC parts and shipping, display, battery and module), from circuit/elixpo/BOM_COST.md.

plans.name: Four months: 25 badges in developers' hands
plans.description: The next four months, ₹3,00,000 in all. Milestones: month 1, the first PCB badges running FaleraOS and a public build guide; month 2, touch, audio and an app tutorial, and 25 badges built and tested for contributors and testers; month 3, board revision 2 with fixes from the first batch; month 4, two workshops where every attendee builds a badge and publishes an app. Each milestone is reported publicly in the repository. Lines: maintainer stipends ₹1,20,000; 25 badges ₹1,00,000; board revision 2 ₹30,000; test equipment ₹25,000; two workshops ₹25,000. Full terms: pitch-deck/SPONSORSHIP.md.

plans.name: Maintainer stipends
plans.description: Three maintainers × ₹10,000 a month for four months (₹1,20,000), paid by milestone, so the work continues at full pace.

plans.name: 25 badges, built and tested
plans.description: 25 Falera Badges for contributors, testers and the two workshops, at ₹4,000 each at 25-unit prices (₹4,172 in parts for the first five, circuit/elixpo/BOM_COST.md).

plans.name: Board revision 2
plans.description: Fabrication and assembly of the next prototypes, with the fixes found on the first five boards.

plans.name: Test equipment
plans.description: A hot-air station, a bench power supply and a logic analyser for bringing up and testing every batch.

plans.name: Two workshops
plans.description: Kits, travel and documentation for two build-and-code workshops: everyone builds a badge and publishes an app to the App Store.

history.description: Income: the community fundraiser, ₹872 from 16 people as of 21 November 2026. Expenses: the first five PCBs (JLCPCB, ₹4,122) and their parts (LCSC, ₹4,063), paid by the maintainers.
